prompts.sky: Production background matte for a 3D side-scrolling skate platform game, Moonbone Vault. Wide landscape 3:2 composition. Crash Bandicoot 4 inspired hand-painted sculptural cartoon art direction mixed with 1990s punk album graphics, lavish but readable brushwork, angular stylized shapes. NIGHT SKY ONLY, no scenery, no buildings, no foreground, no text, no logos. Deep ink-navy upper sky grading to smoky muted blue-violet below, sparse tiny stars and a few graphic four-point stars. One luminous oversized pale turquoise ivory full moon centered at x 57%, y 32%, diameter 17% of image height, crooked chunky crater shapes, soft turquoise halo, beautifully painted not photographic. Keep the lower half dark with subtle painterly haze and plenty of negative space. Few very faint wispy distant clouds, most clouds will be a separate parallax layer. A rich cool quiet backdrop that supports ivory skull monuments and purple punk shrines in the foreground. No floating islands, no sunset, no realistic horror, no purple galaxy nebula.
prompts.clouds: A separate transparent parallax CLOUD layer for Moonbone Vault, a Crash Bandicoot 4 inspired hand-painted 1990s punk skate platform game at night. Wide landscape 3:2 image, truly transparent RGBA background. Several large elongated asymmetrical curling cloud banks stretched horizontally across the lower third and left/right middle edges, leaving the center and upper center mostly transparent for a moon behind. Sculptural cartoon shapes with flattened angular brush facets and hooked ends, deep smoky slate blue and muted indigo shadows, restrained pale cyan moonlit upper edges. Atmospheric and soft edges, chunky painterly brush shapes, no outlines, no bright white clouds. Different sizes and spacing, a cohesive continuous cloud composition, not an icon sheet. No sky background, no moon, no stars, no scenery, no text, no border. Dark subdued colors designed to layer in front of a navy night sky.
prompts.ridge: A transparent foreground cutout MATTE PAINTING of distant Moonbone ossuary ridges for a Crash Bandicoot 4 inspired punk 90s skate platform game. Wide landscape 3:2 composition, RGBA transparent sky. Only the bottom 35 percent occupied by a continuous low jagged ridge of crooked slate cliffs, huge fossil rib tips and a few ruined skeletal arch silhouettes, squat ruined tomb roofs. The upper 65 percent is transparent empty sky. Hand-painted broad angular sculpted brush shapes, low contrast ink navy and desaturated violet-blue silhouettes, restrained turquoise moonlight along select edges, layered atmospheric silhouette shapes. Offbeat playful spooky cartoon game, NOT realistic gothic horror. Asymmetric grouping: two taller ridges toward left and right edges, a low spacious central valley. Detailed enough for production game matte but quiet to support colorful ivory 3D bone props in front. No moon, no stars, no text, no foreground platforms, no green trees, no black outline.
